title: Youth commission list of county-funded youth programs
summary: The Commission on Children and Youth is seeking a list of county-funded youth programs, and the chair hopes it arrives in time for the next meeting packet. A commissioner said the issue is less a lack of resources than a lack of awareness.

timeline.text: The chair hopes the program list arrives before the next meeting so it can go out with the meeting packet.
